### 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan

| Day | Theme | Caption & Hook | Visual Ideas | CTA |
|-----|-------|----------------|--------------|-----|
| **Day 1** | **Launch Teaser** | “Something fresh is dropping soon. Stay tuned. #FadedArchive” | Logo on sleek black background, subtle waves of colour hinting at the collection. | “Follow us for the reveal!” |
| **Day 2** | **Behind‑the‑Scenes** | “From ink to tee: watch a design come to life.” | Short loop of the printing process, close‑up of the ink drop, finished tee in hand. | “Drop a 🎨 in the comments if you want to see the full collection.” |
| **Day 3** | **Product Spotlight #1** | “Meet the ‘Midnight Muse’ tee—soft, stylish, and sustainable.” | Model wearing the tee in a moody setting; highlight the fabric texture. | “Tap to shop & use code LAUNCH15 for 15 % off.” |
| **Day 4** | **Style Guide** | “How to style an Faded Archive tee for day or night.” | Split‑screen: daytime outfit vs. night‑time look, showcasing versatility. | “Tag a friend who’d love this look!” |
| **Day 5** | **Launch Day & Giveaway** | “It’s finally here! Launch Giveaway: Win a free tee.” | Live video announcing launch, flip‑book of all products, giveaway rules. | “Follow, like, & tag 3 friends to enter.” |

- **All posts**: use consistent filter (soft vintage), brand colours (#302f32, #c7b59b), and hashtag bundle (#FadedArchive, #WearYourStory, #TeeTime).
- **Stories**: add polls (“Which tee should we drop next?”), countdown sticker, and “Swipe Up” to shop (once ≥10k followers).
- **Reels**: a 15‑sec reel on Day 3 showing the tee stitching process + upbeat music.

### eBay UK Fees for Clothing (Approximate)

| Item | Listing Fee | Final Value Fee | PayPal Fee (optional) | Notes |
|------|-------------|-----------------|------------------------|-------|
| Fixed‑price auction or okay‑go listing | Free (if under 10 £ per listing) | 10 % of sale price (minimum 0.50 £) | 2.9 % + 0.30 £ per transaction (if using PayPal) | Free if sale < 10 £ per listing; otherwise a € fee applies. |
| Daily deal / marketplace fee | 3 % of sale | 2 % | Same as above | Charges differ if you use eBay’s fulfillment services. |
| Optional “Bold HTML” (image‑rich) | 8 % | 10 % | Same | Use only for premium listings. |

**Quick tip:** Add a flat “£1.00” to the listing price to absorb the 10 % final‑value fee and keep the purchaser’s payment amount static.  

If you sell high‑volume, consider eBay’s *Bulk listing* or *Seller Hub* options to reduce per‑item fees.
